page.content:
Phokus and his brother Priasus were the sons of Kaeneus and were listed among the Argonauts in Hyginus' Fabulae. Other than the part mentioning the Argonauts assembling, the brother are not mentioned in Fabulae.

page.overview:
Who is Phokus?

Phokus and his brother Priasus were the sons of Kaeneus and were listed among the Argonauts in Hyginus' Fabulae. Other than the part mentioning the Argonauts assembling, the brother are not mentioned in Fabulae.

"Phocus and Priasus, son of Caeneus, from Magnesia." - Hyginus, Fabulae, 14
